description: Karachi Zoo (Karachi Zoological and Botanical Gardens, also called Gandhi Garden / Garden Zoo) in Garden East was established in 1899 and is described by Wikipedia as the largest zoo in Pakistan and the country's second oldest after Lahore Zoo. OpenStreetMap tags the site's operator as 'Sindh Government'. Per press coverage dated 29 Dec 2025, Karachi Mayor Barrister Murtaza Wahab inaugurated a new lion enclosure and a renovated Reptile House on 28 Dec 2025 and announced entry fees of Rs 50 (adults) / Rs 30 (children).

name: Chaukhandi Tombs
address: Chaukhandi Tombs, Chowkhandi Road, Abdullah Goth, Bin Qasim Town, Malir District, Karachi Division, Sindh 75030, Pakistan (per OpenStreetMap/Nominatim; UNESCO describes it as '40 km east of Karachi')
subcategory: funerary ensemble / necropolis (UNESCO Tentative List, cultural)
entryConditions: No official published entry conditions found. The necropolis is managed/conserved by the Sindh Culture, Tourism & Antiquities Department (Government of Sindh) per that department's official Facebook page, which posts guided tourist visits at the site (e.g., Jan-Feb 2026 posts). It is an active Muslim graveyard (OSM amenity=grave_yard, religion=muslim) as well as a heritage site.
description: The Chaukhandi necropolis spreads over about two square miles and contains elaborately carved stone tombs of warriors of Saloch families settled in the area during the 17th-18th centuries A.D., per the UNESCO World Heritage Centre tentative-list description (Ref. 1287). Tombs rise on raised platforms in pyramid form with relief-carved stone slabs showing horsemen with arms (shield, sword, bow and arrow), women's ornaments, and turban-holding bosses; some graves sit under pillar canopies finished in Hindu style. It was submitted to Pakistan's UNESCO Tentative List on 14/12/1993 as a cultural property.
